fields.title: Cheapest/smallest and qualification claims exceed the tested model scope
fields.evidence: The finite-element comparisons omit seams, explicit cells, nonlinear materials, the proposed reinforcement, thermal residuals, water loading gradients and nonaxisymmetric modes. Generic handbook/CMH17 stand-in properties lack edition/page or laminate identification. Hardware listings establish size classes, not a qualified process, booking or quotation.
fields.proposed_fix: Describe B as a proposed candidate among the examined options. Keep physical gamma, installed-hull SF and qualified tolerances null; define validated transfer and first-failure mode before applying the outcome bands.

claim: Cheapest/smallest and qualification claims exceed the tested model scope
numerical_scope: Source NFI carried without a new independent check
qualification: 047's regularizing in-plane core moduli remain unsourced, and its face-compression screen uses a tensile proxy. The 1.209–1.227 mm tolerance at SF1 is model-only. The 056 target, 6.03 MPa, is simulated rather than a physical collapse measurement; 6.159 MPa agreement supplies no P2 gamma. [047 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:7472c3f9ee41a250), [056 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:a6b49a9c06df2016).
